settings.text: Rug accessories are a must-have for keeping your favourite rugs in perfect condition; just like any other investment, they require regular care and maintenance. Cleaning products and underlays help to make the most out of your carpets and increase their longevity so that they stand the test of time.

settings.heading: Rug Accessories: Keep your rugs in place and looking like new

settings.text:
Discover our rug accessories, carefully selected to help you maintain a safer, cleaner, and more comfortable home. Whether you’re dealing with slippery floors or stubborn stains, the right accessories, like an anti slip mat for rugs or a spray stain remover can make all the difference.
Perfect for thin rugs and delicate carpets, our accessories are designed to work on all floor types, from hardwood and tile to laminate.

Best anti slip rug underlay for carpets

Struggling with rugs that slip or bunch up? Our rug anti slip underlay options are designed to keep your carpet firmly in place while protecting your floors underneath.

Choose from two popular options:
Anti slip rug underlay
A thick, felt-like underlay that adds cushioning, reduces noise, and prevents slipping. This rug underlay is ideal for thinner rugs and can be easily cut to match any size or shape.

Super stop underlay
This latex-based rug gripper for carpet offers a strong hold on smooth surfaces like wood, tile, or stone. It’s one of the best anti slip rug underlays for carpets and can be trimmed to fit your rug perfectly.

How to use an anti slip mat

  • Lay the underlay flat on a clean surface.
  • Cut it to fit your rug size if necessary.
  • Place your rug on top, and you’re good to go.

How does an anti slip mat work?

An anti slip mat creates friction between the rug and the floor using non-slip textures, preventing movement without damaging either surface.

settings.heading: Stain removers for every rug type

settings.text:
From muddy footprints to red wine spills, a good carpet stain remover is essential for keeping your rugs fresh and long-lasting. While some stains require immediate spot treatment, many modern homes now feature washable rugs and even machine-washable rugs, making maintenance easier than ever. Whether you’re dealing with daily messes or unexpected accidents, combining an effective stain remover with the convenience of washable rugs ensures your home stays clean and inviting with minimal effort.

How to remove a stain from a rug:

  • Act fast: Blot spills with a clean, damp cloth to avoid setting the stain.
  • Use a specialised stain remover spray: Our spray stain remover works on common stains like food, ink, and grass.
  • Washable rugs? Some types, like plastic rugs or bath mats, can be cleaned in the washing machine at 30°C (delicate cycle). Air dry only.
  • Handle with care: For vintage or viscose rugs, avoid harsh chemicals and use cold water with a white cloth.
    Tip: Always read the care label or contact a professional cleaner for persistent stains.
